records.title: Sun-Drenched Loft in Arts District
records.description: Open-concept loft with 14-foot ceilings, exposed brick, and floor-to-ceiling windows facing south. Original hardwood floors throughout. Building has a shared rooftop deck with city views.

reviews.author: Maya T.
reviews.text: Lived here 2 years. The natural light is unreal and the neighborhood keeps getting better.

reviews.author: Jordan K.
reviews.text: Great space and location. Street noise can be loud on weekends but that's the trade-off.

records.title: Modern 2BR with Skyline Views
records.description: Recently renovated corner unit with panoramic skyline views from the 12th floor. Quartz countertops, stainless appliances, and a balcony off the primary bedroom. Full-service building with 24/7 concierge.

reviews.author: Chris L.
reviews.text: The views alone are worth it. Building management is responsive and the gym is solid.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.text: Beautiful apartment. Concierge is very helpful. Wish parking was included.

records.title: Cozy Studio Near the Park
records.description: Efficient studio two blocks from Riverside Park. Murphy bed, built-in shelving, and a surprisingly functional galley kitchen. Quiet tree-lined street. Laundry in basement.

reviews.author: Alex R.
reviews.text: Perfect for one person. The Murphy bed is a game-changer for the small space. Park access is amazing.

reviews.author: Sam W.
reviews.text: Good value for the area. Kitchen is tight but workable. Wish it allowed pets.

records.title: Spacious 3BR Brownstone Floor-Through
records.description: Full floor of a classic brownstone. Original details — crown molding, pocket doors, decorative fireplace — plus a renovated kitchen and updated bath. Private back porch overlooking the garden. Storage in cellar.

reviews.author: Nina D.
reviews.text: This place has so much character. The porch is perfect for morning coffee. Landlord is great.

reviews.author: Marcus J.
reviews.text: Raising a family here. The space is generous and the neighborhood is walkable to everything.

records.title: Luxury Penthouse with Terrace
records.description: Top-floor penthouse with a 400 sqft private terrace. Floor-to-ceiling glass, chef's kitchen with gas range, custom closets. Building features a residents' lounge, co-working space, and cold storage for deliveries.

reviews.author: Elena V.
reviews.text: The terrace is an absolute dream for entertaining. Best apartment I've ever lived in.

reviews.author: David M.
reviews.text: Incredible space and amenities. Rent is steep but you get what you pay for.

records.title: Bright 1BR with Garden Access
records.description: Ground-floor one-bedroom in a restored Victorian with direct access to a shared garden. Original tin ceilings, updated kitchen with butcher-block counters. Quiet block, steps from the farmers' market.

reviews.author: Lena F.
reviews.text: The garden is magical in summer. Quiet neighbors and a gorgeous block.

reviews.author: Raj P.
reviews.text: Charming place with real character. Basement laundry would be a dealbreaker for some but I have in-unit.

records.title: Renovated 2BR Corner Unit
records.description: Corner two-bedroom with windows on three sides and views of the mural district. Gut-renovated in 2025 with new plumbing, wiring, and mini-split AC. Open kitchen with island seating. Pet-friendly building with a courtyard.

reviews.author: Tasha M.
reviews.text: Love the natural light from the corner windows. Renovation is quality — not the cheap-flip kind.

reviews.author: Ian C.
reviews.text: Great layout for roommates. Each bedroom is a real room. Courtyard is a nice bonus.

records.title: Waterfront Studio with Balcony
records.description: Compact studio with a private balcony overlooking the river. Open layout with a sleeping alcove, full kitchen, and in-unit washer/dryer combo. Building has a kayak launch and waterfront walking path.

reviews.author: Dana K.
reviews.text: Waking up to the river every morning never gets old. The balcony is tiny but perfect for coffee.

reviews.author: Miles R.
reviews.text: Great value for waterfront living. Washer/dryer in unit is a huge plus at this price.

records.title: Industrial 3BR with Rooftop
records.description: Converted warehouse loft spanning the full third floor. Polished concrete floors, steel-beam ceilings, and an oversized freight elevator. Private rooftop access with built-in grill and skyline views. Two full baths, one with a soaking tub.

reviews.author: Kai W.
reviews.text: The rooftop is incredible for parties. Industrial vibe is authentic, not the fake exposed-brick kind.

reviews.author: Jess L.
reviews.text: Tons of space for the price. Freight elevator is fun but slow. Neighborhood has great food options.
